g.text: Where did the review pool expand?

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526579

g.text: Original pairs retained, with new candidates added from the expanded method set • 33 sources per major group

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526579

g.text: Each group contains the same number of sampled occupations. More pairs indicate broader review coverage and more review work, not better accuracy.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526579

g.text: The sample includes calibration, probability-test and purposive challenge cases; these counts are not estimates for the full workforce.
